questions.q: Neither of the answers ___ correct.
questions.e:
Correct answer: is
Explanation: With “neither of,” the verb is generally singular in formal exam grammar: “Neither ... is correct.”

questions.q: Choose the correct passive form: “The clerk prepared the report.”
o: The report prepared by the clerk.
The report was prepared by the clerk.
The report is prepared by the clerk yesterday.
The clerk was prepared the report.
questions.e:
Correct answer: The report was prepared by the clerk.
Explanation: The simple past active changes to “was/were + past participle”; report is singular, so “was prepared.”
Exam takeaway: Learn the core rule or concept and distinguish it from nearby terms.

questions.q: The ratio of two numbers is 3:5 and their sum is 64. What is the smaller number?
questions.e:
Correct answer: 24
Explanation: Total parts = 3 + 5 = 8; each part = 64 ÷ 8 = 8; smaller number = 3 × 8 = 24.
Exam takeaway: Learn the core rule or concept and distinguish it from nearby terms.

questions.q: Under India’s flexible inflation-targeting framework, monetary policy primarily aims to:
o: Maintain price stability while keeping growth in mind
questions.e:
Correct answer: Maintain price stability while keeping growth in mind.
Key points: The RBI’s monetary policy framework gives primacy to price stability while keeping growth in mind. The Monetary Policy Committee sets the policy rate within the statutory framework.
Why the other options are incorrect: The Union Budget is a fiscal document; elections are administered by the Election Commission; state tax rates are not all set by RBI monetary policy.
Exam takeaway: Distinguish monetary policy (RBI) from fiscal policy (government taxation and expenditure).
Source: Reserve Bank of India — https://www.rbi.org.in/

questions.q: A can finish a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. Working together at constant rates, how many days will they take?
questions.e:
Correct answer: 6 days
Explanation: A's rate is 1/10 and B's is 1/15; combined rate = 1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6 job per day, so they need 6 days.

questions.q: Shad Suk Mynsiem is primarily associated with which community of Meghalaya?
questions.e:
Correct answer: Khasi.
Key points: Meghalaya Tourism describes Shad Suk Mynsiem as a major Khasi agrarian festival, celebrated in April with traditional dance and music. Its dance formations also reflect aspects of Khasi matrilineal society.
Why the other options are incorrect: Garo, Biate and Mizo communities have distinct cultural traditions; Shad Suk Mynsiem is specifically identified as a Khasi festival.
Exam takeaway: Revise Meghalaya festivals together with the community, season and key cultural features.
Source: Meghalaya Tourism — https://www.meghalayatourism.in/explore/about-meghalaya/dance-music/shad-suk-mynsiem/
